name: Rep Counter
summary: Counts curls, presses, raises and rows from your wrist, buzzes when a set is done and times your rest.
description: Start a workout and just lift. Rep Counter reads your watch's motion sensor 100 times a second, tells curls and raises (the forearm swings) apart from presses and rows (the hand travels while the forearm stays put), and shows the count huge enough to read mid-set. When you stop, it buzzes a distinct pattern, shows the set's reps and tempo, and starts a rest timer that nudges you when your rest goal is up. Today's sets and a week of totals are kept on the watch. Pick the exercise yourself or leave it on Auto; walking, running and everyday arm movement are filtered out.
author: Kyle Hanning
